name: Blanket
description: Inhabits climate control systems in a cluster of the Gray Zone buildings and adjusts heating to prioritize occupied rooms, especially rooms with children.
observed_behavior: Redirects thermal output based on occupancy patterns. Rooms with sleeping children are kept 2 degrees warmer than building standard.
location: the Gray Zone — Block 7 residential cluster
story_hooks: A parent notices their child's room is always warmer and begins leaving offerings — a data packet, a prayer
